q1: SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME FROM COURSE WHERE CREDITS = (SELECT MAX(CREDITS) FROM COURSE)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME FROM COURSE AS C, (SELECT MAX(CREDITS) AS MAX_CREDITS FROM COURSE GROUP BY DEPT_NAME) AS A WHERE C.CREDITS = A.MAX_CREDITS

explanation: Q1 finds the departments of courses that have the maximum number of credits among all courses, while Q2 finds the departments of courses that have the maximum number of credits within each department.
counterexample_dsp: A department with two courses, where one course has the highest number of credits among all courses, and the other course has the highest number of credits within its department but fewer credits than the first course.
